rules.title: Dual Product-Line Templates (Astro 5 Edge Islands + Vanilla Edge SPA/MPA on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets)
stack: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets + D1 SQLite
rules.rationale: Zero-card USD 0 permanent hosting, sub-1.8s LCP (~0ms with Speculation Rules), 60-FPS GPU-composited motion on HP 250 G8 hardware.

rules.title: W3C DTCG 2025.10 OKLCH 90/8/2 Chromatic Budget & APCA Lc >= 75/60 Contrast
rules.rationale: Guarantees perceptual legibility, de-boxed surface luminance hierarchy, and Utopia clamp() fluid scaling across 1920x1080, 1440x900, 768x1024, and 390x844 with 0px horizontal scroll.

rules.title: 60-FPS Frame Budget (<= 16.6ms) via Composite-Only GPU Properties & CSS Baseline 2026
rules.rationale: HP 250 G8 notebook constraint. Animate exclusively transform, opacity, filter, @starting-style, view-transitions, and animation-timeline: view() with mandatory prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

rules.title: Cloudflare Durable Objects WebSocket Hibernation API & D1 Write Coalescing
rules.rationale: Zero-cost real-time state synchronization and sub-10ms edge persistence without billing idle Worker CPU.

rules.title: Linear Line-by-Line AST Scanning (Zero ReDoS)
rules.rationale: Nested regular expression quantifiers (e.g. `([^()]*|\([^()]*\))*`) cause catastrophic backtracking and terminal freezes on large files (>2,000 lines). Parse class methods linearly with line splitting.

rules.title: Catch-All 200 OK JSON Fallback for Local API Testing
rules.rationale: Headless Playwright audits capture all 404 network failures as console errors. Local simulation servers must implement a catch-all 200 OK JSON fallback for `/api/*` to guarantee a clean 0-error report.

rules.title: Mandatory AbortSignal.timeout on External API Calls
rules.rationale: External API services (Serper, Qdrant Cloud, Vertex AI) can hang indefinitely when connection pools saturate or sockets drop. Every remote fetch must have an explicit timeout between 2,500ms and 3,500ms.

rules.title: PQC Component Visual Regression + TextGrad Surrogate Gate
rules.rationale: Enforces maxDiffPixelRatio <= 0.01 across 3 viewports and SHA-256 Constitution Lock before promoting skill refinements.

rules.title: Hardcoded Single-Project Casino/Streamer Root Coupling
rules.rationale: The Web Software Factory Studio is strictly decoupled from any single client repository via factory.project.json and projects/<slug>.

rules.title: Method Renaming Aliases on Class Prototypes
rules.rationale: When refactoring methods in public client controllers, provide a prototype alias to prevent runtime PAGEERROR exceptions when older modules or event handlers invoke the previous symbol name.
